title: Into the Omniverse: How Developers Turn Ideas Into Simulations With Frontier AI Agents
hook_text: AI agents are building simulations now.
hook_before: Nvidia just introduced frontier AI agents to Omniverse libraries.
script:
Nvidia just added frontier AI agents to Omniverse.
Developers are using them to connect physics and rendering automatically.
These agents assemble complex assets and test how scenes behave.
Teams can explore scenarios and investigate failures faster than ever.
Would you trust an AI to design your next physics simulation?
